title: Doodling Dumbo Octopus
statement: A thumb-sized, ear-flapping octopus that inks curly doodles in the sand, rearranges pebbles into constellations, and blushes a new rainbow pattern every time it gets curious. It lives in a lamp-warm cove of kelp, glass bubbles, and tiny collected treasures, forever tinkering, exploring, and napping in a teacup.
